decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the construction of a  rear roof extensions with two rooflights at the front to the dwelling house at 153 Worple  Road would not harm the appearance the existing building or the character of the surrounding area and would protect neighbours' living conditions. The proposal is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) within the Unitary Development Plan (December 2003), and the relevant provisions of the Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the roof extension is used.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension and 2 x rooflights to front elevation of existing house.
